name: Mahoutsukai no Kusuriya
source:
Once upon a time, in an era when humans and wizards still hated each other's existence,
a very gentle wizard who ran a apothecary lived there.

[From [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/6432]NovelGame[/url]]
translation:
曾几何时，在一个人类和巫师仍然互相憎恨对方存在的时代，
一位非常温柔的巫师住在那里，他经营着一家药店。

[来自[url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/6432]NovelGame[/url]]
